summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville Capital on September 23, 2026. The company issued 182,091 shares to cut $1,678,320 from its 2021 secured note, and 547,898 shares to retire the remaining $5,049,909.26 of its 2025 secured note, which was fully paid and cancelled. Shares were issued under Section 3(a)(9). Post-transaction, roughly 1,463,958 shares were outstanding as of September 24, 2026. Watch for further note exchanges, dilution from Streeterville resales, and any remaining 2021 note balance.
